trigger: No exact board/chip match
design_notes: Dedicated design; show product number

trigger: Matching profile is developer-only
design_notes: Needs design pass: current This board requires developer mode screen is not approved; redesign its presentation and entry flow

trigger: Host macOS below board minimum
design_notes: Explain minimum and current versions

trigger: IORegistry or boot environment cannot be read
design_notes: Distinguish probe failure from unsupported hardware

trigger: Primary macOS or machine-owner records cannot be identified
design_notes: No early credential screen

trigger: Console login is not a machine-owner administrator
design_notes: Explain which account is required

trigger: Internal disk or GUID/APFS layout is not supported
design_notes: Show supported layout requirements

trigger: Maximum reclaimable space is below the installation minimum
user_actions: Free space in macOS; check again; quit
design_notes: Needs design pass: You need more space on this Mac; distinct from merely choosing too little Linux space

trigger: Selected Linux allocation is zero or below the image minimum
user_actions: Move boundary left to allocate more to Linux
design_notes: Needs design pass: initial zero allocation and below-minimum variants; do not imply the Mac lacks capacity

trigger: Moving left would leave less than 2 GB free inside macOS
user_actions: Choose a smaller Linux allocation; free space in macOS
design_notes: Needs design pass: show the macOS free-space limit and why movement stops

trigger: macOS already has less than the required free-space margin
user_actions: Free space in macOS; check again
design_notes: Needs design pass: distinguish existing macOS pressure from Linux allocation; macOS is never enlarged

trigger: APFS hard minimum prevents further macOS shrinking despite reported free bytes
user_actions: Keep current split; inspect snapshots; check again
design_notes: Needs design pass: distinguish APFS limits from the installer margin

trigger: Selected image needs more Linux space than the current allocation
user_actions: Go back and adjust boundary; choose a smaller image
design_notes: Needs design pass: distinguish a fixable allocation from insufficient total capacity

trigger: Other APFS groups cannot be inspected read-only
design_notes: Do not silently present a destructive option

trigger: No compatible CDN image is available for this board/mode
user_actions: Check again; developer options; choose Bootloader only; quit
design_notes: Distinguish an empty image list from an unreachable CDN

trigger: CDN image listing is unavailable or malformed
user_actions: Retry; check network; copy details; quit
design_notes: Board support remains compiled; do not imply unsupported hardware

trigger: Invalid name, size, target or software selection
design_notes: Prefer field-specific feedback

trigger: Plan expired or layout/release differs from reviewed plan
design_notes: Never auto-approve the changed plan

trigger: Username or password is empty
design_notes: One sheet per boot stage

trigger: Password is incorrect or Apple rejects machine-owner authentication
disk_state: unchanged unless later Apple tool rejects
design_notes: Distinguish typo from authorization policy failure

trigger: macOS refuses to start the privileged session
design_notes: No separate Authorize screen

trigger: User cancels the password sheet
design_notes: No work starts and password field clears

trigger: Privileged-session handshake times out
design_notes: Keep review intact

trigger: Compiled boot object or branding resource is absent
design_notes: Installer packaging failure

trigger: Insufficient temporary space for recovery validation
design_notes: Different from space reserved for Linux

trigger: Offline, DNS, TLS, server, timeout or retry failure
design_notes: Download progress and retry variant needed

trigger: Checksum, CRC or HTTP-range validation fails
design_notes: Never offer bypass

trigger: Restore identity, version, member, hash, AEA decode or DMG verify fails
design_notes: Board-specific recovery qualification failure

trigger: Local factory, radio, camera, audio or restore input is missing
user_actions: Return to supported macOS; retry; copy details
design_notes: Do not request firmware from a third-party server

trigger: Conflicting factory records, malformed calibration or unsupported firmware build
design_notes: Do not offer another device calibration or verification bypass

current_surface: Returns to review with generic alert
trigger: Authorization or validation fails before resize/create events
design_notes: No warning that partitions were already changed

trigger: Resize, volume, write, format, bootability, default boot or security step fails
user_actions: Keep logs; inspect current state; repair if stage 1 is ready
design_notes: Needs dedicated partial-install design; no blanket fresh-install retry

trigger: Privileged process or IPC connection ends unexpectedly
disk_state: unknown; determine from last completed step
user_actions: Keep logs; recheck installation; avoid duplicate install
design_notes: Do not promise rollback or cancellation

trigger: App opened in normal macOS or ordinary recovery
user_actions: Show 1TR guide; shut down; check again
design_notes: Different from wrong pairing

trigger: Recovery environment is not paired with chosen installation
user_actions: Choose correct startup volume; guide; check again
design_notes: Name the required installation

trigger: Saved first stage is not ready
user_actions: Return to macOS; repair; copy details
design_notes: Explain why finalization cannot proceed

trigger: Missing/corrupt record, volume IDs, hardware match or boot object
design_notes: Do not fall back to another board or volume

trigger: Saved finalization is already complete
design_notes: Already-complete variant should not request credentials

trigger: bputil fails after authorization
user_actions: Copy details; recheck status; retry finalization
design_notes: Show completed versus remaining steps

trigger: kmutil or final recovery cleanup fails
design_notes: Do not claim successful Linux installation

trigger: One existing managed installation is detected
design_notes: Alternate entry flow needs design

trigger: Multiple existing installations are detected
design_notes: Show identity and completion state clearly

trigger: Repair requested
design_notes: Explain files retained and startup changes

trigger: Stage-1 firmware upgrade requested
design_notes: Distinguish installer update from installed bootloader upgrade

trigger: Uninstall requested
design_notes: Destructive operation needs its own visual treatment

trigger: Legacy/unmanaged/changed/non-adjacent partition manifest
user_actions: Copy details; use documented manual process
design_notes: Explain why automatic removal is disabled

trigger: Repair, upgrade or uninstall fails
design_notes: Different variants for removal and repair

trigger: Uninstall completes
design_notes: Alternate completion state needs design

trigger: Shutdown or restart request fails or no privileged session remains
user_actions: Retry when possible; use Apple menu
design_notes: Never imply install failed solely because restart failed

trigger: App is updating or an active session blocks replacement
design_notes: Desktop presentation not designed

trigger: Archive, checksum, destination or atomic deployment fails
disk_state: previous app retained when deployment fails
user_actions: Retry; keep current app; show details
design_notes: Separate from Linux disk-install failure
